name: imap-mail
description: Read IMAP mail, save unsent drafts or submit explicitly authorized SMTP messages with private signatures and attachments. No deletion.

interface.shortDescription: Read mail, save drafts or explicitly send via SMTP
interface.longDescription: Read IMAP mail, save reviewed unsent drafts or submit explicitly requested SMTP messages. Sending requires separate account opt-in and a send-specific immutable preview. Distinguishes SMTP acceptance from Sent-copy verification and delivery; blocks blind uncertain retries. Credentials remain private on the configured host. No deletion, OAuth, cloud hosting, or background sorting.
